cards.title: Inputs
cards.body: `<input>` is a box people type into. Its `type` sets the kind: `text`, `email`, `password` and more.

cards.title: Labels
cards.body: `<label>` names an input. Give the input an `id` and the label the same `for`, and clicking the label jumps into the box.

cards.title: Buttons
cards.body: `<button>` makes a button. Inside a `<form>`, a `type="submit"` button sends the form.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: Pressing the button empties the box instead of sending the form. Which line is wrong?
cards.code:
<form>
  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email">
  <button type="reset">Sign me up</button>
</form>

bug.fix: `type="reset"` clears the form. To send it, the button needs `type="submit"`.

check.question: Which input is best for an email address?
check.explanation: `type="email"` checks the address and shows the right keyboard on phones. `mail` is not a real type.

exercise.prompt: Make a sign-up `<form>` with a `<label>`, an email `<input>`, and a submit button that says `Sign up`.
